description: Medora is a multidisciplinary student team from Dhaka, Bangladesh, passionate about AI/ML, software development, data analysis, visualization, and creative problem-solving. We aim to build innovative solutions using NASA open data and space-related technologies. Our team combines skills in AI/ML, coding, web development, UI/UX, research, data visualization, and communication for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
summary:
AstraHealth is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform developed by Team Medora for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It addresses the challenges of monitoring astronaut health during long-duration space missions, where microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, and communication delays can make health management difficult.

The platform brings together NASA space research, physiological health indicators, personalized baseline analysis, machine learning-based risk assessment, explainable insights, radiation monitoring, and an AI-powered health copilot. Its seven modules help users monitor crew health, identify potential risks, understand contributing factors, and explore appropriate countermeasures.

AstraHealth aims to support astronauts and mission teams with more informed, data-driven health decisions, especially when immediate access to Earth-based support is limited.

It can also support remote communities, ships, and polar stations.
AstraHealth. Protect the Astronaut.
details:
AstraHealth is designed as an integrated astronaut health intelligence platform. It combines NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) research resources with health-monitoring indicators and machine learning-based analysis to support astronaut health assessment.

The platform follows a workflow of Collect, Compare, Detect, Explain, Act, and Re-monitor. It provides seven modules: Mission and Crew Dashboard, Personal Health Monitoring, AI Risk Assessment, Countermeasure and Recovery, Deep Space Mode, ASTRA AI Copilot, and Radiation Monitoring and Protection.

Its machine learning capabilities support health-risk analysis, while explainable insights help users understand contributing factors. The Gemini-powered ASTRA AI Copilot enables natural-language interaction with health information and research context.

The project was developed using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and supporting libraries. It is deployed on Vercel, with its source code maintained on GitHub.

AstraHealth aims to improve astronaut health awareness and decision support during long-duration missions, particularly when communication delays make immediate Earth-based assistance difficult. It is a research prototype and is intended to support, not replace, qualified medical and mission professionals.
